<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/people.ts -->
<!--
  The people of a team: portrait cards, a minimal grid of small portraits, detailed cards with skills, rows
  beside a picture, or a directory of two columns. Axes: layout (cards, minimal, detailed, list, directory),
  cols, tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Member } from "./team-grid.types";

export type TeamGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  members: Member[];
  depts: Record<string, string>;
  layout?: "cards" | "minimal" | "detailed" | "list" | "directory";
  cols?: "1-3" | "1-4";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import MemberRow from "../components/member-row.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  members,
  depts,
  layout = "cards",
  cols = "1-4",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<TeamGridProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :layout="(((layout as string) === 'list') ? 'split' : 'stack')"
    :media="{ show: ((layout as string) === 'list'), side: 'start', align: 'start' }"
  >
    <Box
      :class="
        (layout as string) === 'minimal' ? 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-8 md:grid-cols-4'
        : (layout as string) === 'directory' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'
        : (layout as string) === 'list' ? 'flex flex-col gap-4'
        : (cols as string) === '1-3' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'
        : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4'
      "
      data-testid="items"
    >
      <template v-for="m in members" :key="m.id">
        <Stack
          v-if="((layout as string) === 'minimal')"
          gap="2"
          align="center"
          class="text-center"
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <MediaFrame :alt="m.name" ratio="1/1" :class="cn('size-16', 'shrink-0')" />
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ m.name }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ m.role }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Stack
          v-else-if="((layout as string) === 'cards')"
          gap="4"
          class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <MediaFrame :alt="m.name" ratio="1/1" />
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Stack gap="0">
              <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
                {{ m.name }}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {{ m.role }}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ m.bio }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
        <MemberRow v-else :member="m" :depts="depts" :layout="layout" />
      </template>
    </Box>
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="3/4" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
